purpose: Integrate exact preflighted feature SHAs into canonical main while keeping parallel as an exact delivery compatibility alias.
preconditions: feature/** exact SHA has passed routed feature preflight against main
required exact feature-SHA delivery profile gates have passed
current main HEAD is re-read inside the serialized integration queue

ref_update.expected_behavior: main and parallel advance together to one exact integrated SHA

on_ref_rejected_or_head_changed: re-run routed feature preflight against the fresh main HEAD
create a fresh merge commit and retry within the queue

serialized: final canonical main integration and atomic main/parallel ref movement

prohibitions: treating parallel as an independent integration base
routing ordinary new work to work
force-pushing main or parallel to resolve queue races
reusing exact-SHA CI evidence for a different feature or integrated SHA
